name: RuMedBench
description: An open Russian medical language understanding benchmark covering multiple task types including classification, question answering, natural language inference, and named entity recognition. It provides unified labeling, data splits, evaluation metrics, and baseline models for Russian medical NLP tasks.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark for Russian medical NLP; it is cited in the Russian-language medical NLP community but is not a widely used global standard.
notes: Includes human evaluation; models outperform humans on large-scale classification but not on knowledge-intensive tasks.
